title: SOA-C03: the operations loop this guide is built on

steps.title: Detect
steps.note: Classify the signal: CloudWatch alarm, metric filter, EventBridge rule, Config rule, CloudTrail

steps.title: Analyze
steps.note: Logs Insights in place; CloudTrail for who, Config for before and after; Flow Logs for traffic

steps.title: Act
steps.note: Sized to the fix: EC2 action on the alarm, Run Command, Automation runbook, Config remediation

steps.title: Prevent
steps.note: CloudFormation change sets and drift detection, StackSets, State Manager, Patch Manager

caption: Place the question at one step of the loop first; only then read the options.
